title: Fix ReadinessScoreRing visibility issue on Dashboard and Skill Gap pages

requirements.text: Fix the ReadinessScoreRing component so it is always visible on the Dashboard and Skill Gap pages. The ring must render the score percentage and SVG ring at all times — including when the user has no study plan (display 0%), when the query is loading (show a skeleton), and when a backend error occurs (fall back to 0% silently without showing an error message). Remove any error boundary or conditional rendering path that hides the ring or shows 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'

quotes: can reslove the issue and amke it wrk

acceptanceCriteria: The ReadinessScoreRing SVG ring is visible on the Dashboard page at all times after page load.
The ReadinessScoreRing SVG ring is visible on the Skill Gap page at all times after page load.
When no study plan exists, the ring displays 0% with the 'Ready' label and no error message.
When the backend call fails or returns an error, the ring falls back to 0% without showing any error state to the user.
During loading, a skeleton placeholder is shown and transitions to the ring once data resolves.
The ring color follows the red/amber/green thresholds: 0–33% red, 34–66% amber, 67–100% green.

requirements.text: Audit the `getReadinessScore` backend function in `backend/main.mo` to ensure it never traps or throws under any authenticated user scenario. It must return 0 as a Nat when the user has no profile, no study plan, or an empty task list. Add defensive null/empty checks for all intermediate data access paths.

quotes: can reslove the issue and amke it wrk

acceptanceCriteria: Calling `getReadinessScore` when no profile exists returns 0 without trapping.
Calling `getReadinessScore` when a profile exists but no study plan has been generated returns 0 without trapping.
Calling `getReadinessScore` when a study plan has 0 tasks returns 0 without a division-by-zero trap.
The function always returns a Nat between 0 and 100 inclusive.

requirements.text: In `useQueries.ts`, update the `useGetReadinessScore` React Query hook so that any thrown error or rejected promise from the backend is caught and resolved as 0 rather than propagating to an error state. Set `retry: false` and use an `onError` or `select` handler to default to 0 on failure.

quotes: can reslove the issue and amke it wrk

acceptanceCriteria: The `useGetReadinessScore` hook never enters an `isError` state; it always resolves with a number (defaulting to 0 on failure).
No error is surfaced to UI components consuming this hook.
The hook does not retry failed backend calls, preventing repeated error loops.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo (single-actor architecture).
Do not change the existing data models or schema in the backend.
nonGoals: Adding new features or changing the readiness score calculation formula.
Redesigning the ReadinessScoreRing visual style beyond what is already implemented.
Changing any other dashboard or skill gap page components unrelated to the score ring.
